'''2000 Connecticut State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Connecticut on 16 April 2000. [[Steve Brentson]] won it. It is known from Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d533">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-connnecticut-state-championship-4-16-00d533/ connnecticut-state-championship-4-16-00], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 16 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-connnecticut-state-championship-4-16-00d533/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Connecticut
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
